subject: Split billing & collection schedule for Acme Cloud (EU / US entities)
messages:
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@acme.eu>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-corp-procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Purchase order + split invoice request (PO#78912)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is ready to move forward. Attached is PO#78912 for 150 seats (12-month term). Acme Europe (Acme B.V.) will pay for 110 seats, and Acme US (Acme Inc.) will pay for the remaining 40 seats.

Two important items for finance:
- We need a single invoice that clearly shows the split amounts per legal entity and which lines are subject to EU VAT (Acme B.V.).
- For the EU portion, our tax team will handle reverse-charge (we will provide VAT registration once you confirm the billed entity).
- Please include cost center tags so our internal routing can auto-post. Acme wants: CLOUD-OPS (EU) for the 110 seats, and ENTERPRISE-SALES (US) for the 40 seats.

Can you confirm the billed legal entities on your side, and circulate a split invoice we can attach to our PO? Also confirm payment terms and whether we should route payment to Redwood USA or Redwood Luxembourg.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — PO is time-sensitive.

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Ivanov
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Cloud Solutions
Attachment: PO_78912.pdf (1 page, PDF)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@acme.eu>
Cc: acme-corp-procurement@acme.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order + split invoice request (PO#78912)

Hi Sasha,

Thanks — got the PO and the headcount breakdown. We can produce a single PDF invoice that contains two legal-entity lines: Redwood EU SRL (for the 110 seats billed to Acme B.V.) and Redwood, Inc. (for the 40 seats billed to Acme Inc.).

A few clarifying points before I generate the invoice:
- Please confirm the VAT number for Acme B.V. so we can add the reverse-charge note on the EU line.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days net. If Acme needs 45-day terms, loop finance (Marissa) and we can evaluate.
- Which bank/entity would you like the funds routed to? I can provide wire details for Redwood, Inc. (US) and Redwood Luxembourg (EU).

I've looped in Marissa from Finance to prepare the split invoice template and Ben for ledger mapping / cost-center tags.

Will await the VAT number and remit preference — I can turn around the split invoice same day once we have that.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Purchase order + split invoice request (PO#78912) — action: split invoice + ledger mapping

Team — quick request from Acme (PO#78912). They want one invoice that splits charge between Acme B.V. (EU) and Acme Inc. (US) by seat count: 110 / 40. Key requirements:

Invoice structure we should produce: 
- Line 1: Product: Redwood Platform — 110 seats x $250/mo x 12 months = $330,000 -> Bill from Redwood Luxembourg (EUR invoice is fine, but keep amounts in USD for now per contract)
- Line 2: Product: Redwood Platform — 40 seats x $250/mo x 12 months = $120,000 -> Bill from Redwood, Inc. (US)
- Include a VAT line on Line 1: note 'reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by Acme B.V.' (we will not collect VAT).
- Attach PO_78912.pdf to the invoice bundle and add cost center tags: CLOUD-OPS (for line 1), ENTERPRISE-SALES (for line 2).

Routing & ledger notes (please propose):
- We need the invoice to post: 100-ACCT-RED (revenue) but split revenue recognition mapping for internal reporting: 100-ACCT-RED-EU / 100-ACCT-RED-US.
- Cash application: if payment arrives to Redwood Luxembourg for the EU amount, it should clear EU AR and not be netted against US AR.

Collections cadence: Acme asked for a collection schedule they can attach to their PO. Can we propose: invoice day 0, payment due in 30 days; if EU payment is delayed >45 days, auto-send SSO reminder to procurement and cc legal.
Can Marissa draft the split-invoice PDF and Ben can confirm GL tags and the cost-center fields we should embed? Karthik, if any tax clearance docs needed for reverse-charge, flag them (we may need Acme's VAT).
Thanks — target to send to Acme today if VAT number is returned.
— Hannah
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Purchase order + split invoice request (PO#78912) — ledger mapping proposal

Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks, looking at this now. Proposed ledger mapping and cost-center payload we can embed in the invoice metadata (and also in the remittance stub):
- Invoice header: invoice_reference = ACME-78912-20261120
- Line 1 (EU): product_sku = RED-PLAT-ENT; qty = 110; unit_price = 250.00; line_total = 330000.00; billed_entity = Redwood Luxembourg SARL; gl_account = 4000-REVENUE-EU; cost_center = CLOUD-OPS
- Line 2 (US): product_sku = RED-PLAT-ENT; qty = 40; unit_price = 250.00; line_total = 120000.00; billed_entity = Redwood, Inc.; gl_account = 4000-REVENUE-US; cost_center = ENTERPRISE-SALES

Tax treatment: for Line 1 we will add the text: '0% VAT — reverse charge. Acme B.V. VAT#: <pending>'. We will not calculate VAT or collect it. For Line 2 we will show US jurisdiction as exempt / non-VAT.

Banking & cash apply:
- Provide two bank remittance blocks in the invoice: 
  * Redwood Luxembourg — IBAN / BIC (for EU funds)
  * Redwood, Inc. — ACH / wire instructions (for US funds)

Collections schedule: agreed — 30 days net for both lines. For EU delays >45 days we will escalate to Hannah + legal as proposed.

I'll attach a draft invoice stub (PDF) and an accounting CSV we can drop straight into the AR import. Marissa — can you confirm whether we should issue the invoice in EUR with USD equivalents or issue both in USD? Customer asked to keep USD on the contract, but local entity prefers EUR reporting. Leaning to USD master with EUR equivalent in parentheses.

Attachment: Redwood_SplitInvoice_EU-US_20261120.pdf (draft stub), acme_ar_import_78912.csv
— Ben
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@acme.eu>
Cc: acme-corp-procurement@acme.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Split invoice and collection schedule (PO#78912)

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for the VAT number: NL123456789B01 (Acme B.V.). Attached is the split invoice bundle and a one-page collections schedule you can attach to PO#78912. Summary: 
- Total contract (12 months): $450,000
  * Bill to Acme B.V. (EU / CLOUD-OPS): $330,000 — billed by Redwood Luxembourg SARL — VAT: reverse charge (Acme B.V. VAT NL123456789B01)
  * Bill to Acme Inc. (US / ENTERPRISE-SALES): $120,000 — billed by Redwood, Inc. — no VAT collected
- Payment terms: Net 30 days from invoice date. Banking details for each billed entity are included in the invoice.
- Cost center tags: CLOUD-OPS / ENTERPRISE-SALES included in invoice metadata and remittance stub.
- Ledger mapping: GL accounts 4000-REVENUE-EU and 4000-REVENUE-US; AR will be split accordingly.

Next steps: please confirm which bank the payments will be sent to and whether Acme prefers USD or EUR settlement for the EU portion. If USD, note currency conversion risks on your side — the invoice shows USD with an EUR equivalent for reporting.

If everything looks good, we'll issue the final invoice (ACME-78912-20261120) and send an invoice PDF + accounting CSV for your AP system.

Thanks for the quick info — we aimed to keep this as a single bundle for your records per your request.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_SplitInvoice_EU-US_20261120.pdf, PO_78912.pdf
